questions.question: If A is the brother of B, C is the father of D, F is the daughter of E, L is the brother of D's father, B is the sister of L and E is the wife of C, then how is F related to A?
questions.solution:
The Family tree chart for the given data is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9e0b1b51a4b88f1f42bd622587ace2855c2f932ada76b29fdfe9866858d9934.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56ce63898180bfd0d2146a8f1a0abb2e82fe42b6a53656dcdddebfb1c784e69a.png] 

Clearly, **F is the niece of A.**

questions.question: Pointing to the photograph of Amit, Gagan, said, 'His sister's mother's husband is my daughter's mother's husband's father. 'How is Amit related to Gagan?
questions.solution:
Given,

Pointing to the photograph of Amit, Gagan, said, 'His sister's mother's husband is my daughter's mother's husband's father.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ca9c3b5e77f1fdcb65c1a9d98983431f188cdfa2efda6f37dc5b848a730bd9e.png]

questions.question: Vedika is the wife of Gaurav. Meeta is the daughter of Malti. Yashwant is the son of Bhuvan. Priyank is the husband of Rohan's mother. Bhuvan is the paternal grandfather of Meeta. Rohan is the son of Vedika's brother. Gaurav is the husband of Kadambini's daughter. Rohan is the brother of Meeta. Which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: Yashwant, Priyank and Gaurav are the sons of Bhuvan.
Malti is the wife of Bhuvan's son.
Vedika is the sister of Yashwant.
Vedika is the daughter of Bhuvan.

questions.solution:
Symbols used to draw family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26bd089b50ccc65418062a914a10405a9c41cac7d59b1a2ba35d018959360e54.png] 

Drawing the family tree according to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d17c4207ffc7914a62debca6c22930cde6b71bd860d5e28ed7cc862d84fd4244.png] 

From the given statements, the wrong statement is 'Yashwant, Priyank and Gaurav are the sons of Bhuvan'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Yashwant, Priyank and Gaurav are the sons of Bhuvan"**.

questions.question:
There are 9 members, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K, in a joint family. There are three married couples in the family. D is a teacher and the brother of E and F. G is the mother of I. J is the wife of C, and C is the grandfather of I. E is the only daughter of C. K is the daughter of F and H.

Who is the wife of the teacher?
questions.solution:
There are 9 members, **C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K**, in a joint family. There are three married couples in the family.

 
• D is a teacher and the brother of E and F.
 
• G is the mother of I.
 
• J is the wife of C, and C is the grandfather of I.
 
• E is the only daughter of C.
 
• K is the daughter of F and H.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e71551bc8def2c20e8adc9084f18ee507500753180604ce8517f15270907db5.png] 

D is the teacher and his wife is G.

Hence, ‘**G**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seeing a portrait, Ruchi asked Seema, "Whose portrait is this?". Seema replied, "Her son is the father of my daughter". Whose portrait is it?
questions.solution:
According to the statement given by Seema,

Her (seema's mother-in-law's) son is the father (seema's husband) of my (seema's) daughter.

Therefore, lady in the portrait is seema's mother-in-law.

The below given diagram represents the relationship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7627b0720e2f281845636cfe11af3719eea0633543ab1386b801689f4f2bcc36.png] 

Hence, **Seema's m****other-in-law** is correct.

questions.question: Ranjan is the father of Ritesh, who is the maternal grandfather of Sunny. Dakshita is the only daughter of Reema. Shikha is the mother-in-law of Reema. Ritesh is the only son of Shikha. Pallavi is the sister of Sunny. How is Dakshita related to Sunny?
questions.solution:
Family chart :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749b5b689090c8a303af7be8d3e16c0fd60e1068fd8dc460dddfc628895fff49.png] 

Family Tree :

1) Ranjan is the father of Ritesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31fa232a0d459c9a197ea43ac258e54648a3eb90e6f73b19e544e1b2f777c203.png] 

2) Ritesh is the only son of Shikha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c17f19b42b94066df4e9b1ca65036c27f9e23ac7fd97dac16910cdb62d711b0.png] 

3) Shikha is the mother-in-law of Reema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b92254ae1f9f0be83eed5d4f2901050698ba706871f0794ffefda537d66d6e4c.png] 

4) Dakshita is the only daughter of Reema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/763e9f4e845570f3cc8b747aa480e6ec631d280657a51ed3185811a74e73af9c.png] 

5) Ritesh, who is the maternal grandfather of Sunny and Pallavi is the sister of Sunny.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/577325f1ef3da22abf6a554ac1098315d72cd4a63bbd38ea906174da78bcdbb9.png] 

∴ Here, Dakshita is mother of sunny.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Mother".**
